content.text: No auto-renewal mechanic exists anywhere in the agreement, so no redline is warranted.

input.quote: 13.1 Term. This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and, unless terminated earlier pursuant to this Article 13, shall continue in full force and effect, on a Product-by-Product and country-by-country basis until the Secondary Royalty Term with respect to such Product expires, at which time this Agreement shall expire in its entirety with respect to such Product in such country.
input.rationale: Section 13.1 sets a single, self-executing term running on a Product-by-Product and country-by-country basis until expiry of the Secondary Royalty Term; there is no automatic renewal, no rolling renewal term, no non-renewal notice window and no renewal price-uplift mechanic anywhere in the Agreement (searches for renewal/extension language return only patent-term references and Section 14.4). Section 14.4 ("No Renewal, Extension or Waiver") reinforces this by providing that continued dealings after expiry or termination "shall not be construed as a renewal or extension hereof," so any extension would require a fresh mutual written agreement — the preferred position. The automatic-renewal conditional elements (12-month renewal term, 30-day opt-out, 60-day Vendor reminder) and the price-cap elements are not triggered because renewal is not automatic and no renewal pricing is contemplated. On expiry, Ono's Section 2.1 licences convert to perpetual, fully paid-up, royalty-free licences, which is favourable to us. No redline proposed.
